a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan (two operate rounds, then take) gives us both about a 4% chance of surviving. So I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you'd rather operate afterward, I'll give back or help where I can.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I told you I would. I won't take anything more. From here I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. If no storm hits, I'll keep running the generator with you.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
